svg.title: 568-70.9001 overview: the whole machine on one page (thread t5, redrawn 2026, not an original document)
svg.text: Adast Maxima MS 115 PS (serial 578.0009, 1998), wiring set 568-70.9001 [SCHÉMA ZAPOJENÍ]: overview of the whole machine
Redrawn 2026 by thread t5 from netlist/merged_devices.csv and merged_cores.csv (not an original document). Each device is drawn once, in the block of the sheet that shows its circuit;
the grey numbers after a name are all the 568 sheets that show it (sheet 1 = device list). Wiring detail: the sheet pages; cores between cabinet, console and machine: connections.svg.
CONSOLE, operator side, above the knife opening
MACHINE: field devices on the machine body
Clamp beam: brake and position sensors
plus 8 cores on the machine from the knife sensors' terminal strip to the sensors (leg B4-K)
Backgauge feed motor and air cushion
certificate entry — (dash); no box in the 3D (three-dimensional) scheme
Mains feed, main switch and power part
frequency inverter of the backgauge feed
power-supply board: +27 V, +24 V, +33 V rectified; ~24 V, ~48 V alternating
parts on the power-supply board, all on sheet 3:
Control relays, cut cycle, magnets and safety
contactors, timers, relays and the cut-control module
RC (resistor-capacitor) coil suppressors, free-wheel diode, series resistor
CABINET [ROZVADĚČ] at the left end of the machine
= [?] unclear, on the on-site list measure_list.md;
cable bundle with the number of cores it carries (netlist/merged_cores.csv); routes estimated, unseen legs ±200 mm (millimetres); the 3D routes are in viewer/index.html.
Cabinet and console devices are boxes at their photographed places in the 3D scheme; field devices sit on the anchors of the stage-1 mechanical model.
